{{Top}}
'''Pirate King''' was a title held by some [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leaders. Its [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] equivalent was [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]].

This title was held by the [[King of the Phosphura Belt Pirates]].<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref> During the [[Western Reaches Operation]], several pirates holding this title supported the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]].<ref name="TGoKA">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref> It was also used to designate the former pirate and [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xer VIII]] after he had taken control of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], although he completely gave up his pirate activity and ruled as a true monarch.<ref name="XW">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> This title was sometimes used to designate the pirate [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] after he took control and ruled the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
